proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requiring a Political Contributions Congruency Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing whether political, lobbying, and electioneering expenditures are congruent with publicly stated company values and policies, listing incongruent instances.
proposals.evidence: we recommend voting AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Seeking Shareholder Ratification of Termination Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Requests shareholder approval of any senior manager pay package providing severance or termination payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target short-term bonus.
proposals.evidence: The Board has recommended a vote against this proposal for the reasons set forth following the proposal.
